title: Yummy Australian Fish Poke
description: A crisp, sour, post‑workout poke featuring fresh tuna, avocado, cucumber, pineapple, bay leaves and a dash of tempered chocolate.
instructions: Dice 200 g of fresh tuna into bite‑size cubes.
Slice half an avocado into thin slices.
Dice half a cucumber and 50 g of pineapple into small cubes.
Juice one lime and pour the juice over the fruit.
Whisk together one tablespoon of low‑sodium soy sauce, one teaspoon of sesame oil, and one teaspoon of mirin into a sauce.
Add the tuna, avocado, cucumber, pineapple, and the sauce mixture into a mixing bowl.
Gently toss the ingredients until everything is coated.
Crush two bay leaves and sprinkle them over the poke.
Let the poke rest for five minutes.
Melt ten grams of 70‑percent cacao dark chocolate in a microwave or doubleboiler and temper it to 31‑32°C.
Drizzle the tempered chocolate over the poke.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and a pinch of chili flakes if desired, then serve immediately over shredded lettuce or with crisp cucumber ribbons.
